treasury.construction: 10Y par bond at month-end yield; semiannual coupons; hold 1 month; reprice remaining 9y11m cash flows at next month-end 10Y yield (single-yield, fractional-period discounting); dirty-price total return; roll monthly. Day count: 1/12-year steps. Limits: single-yield curve approximation; par-coupon simplification; month-end timing; weekly-sampled month ends; FRED vintage revisions.
